## [v0.1.0] - 2026-09-13

### Added

- Added a standalone voice-config-driven Piper frontend with text and eSpeak backends
- Added opt-in G2Lex and Lexphon adapters with pronunciation overlays and raw-block precedence
- Added reusable facades, caching, annotations, language routing, markers, and stress controls to the public API

### Changed

- Improved lexicon resolution, configuration validation, and compatibility checks across supported profiles
- Improved package versioning with source control metadata and release-artifact validation
- Changed runtime dependency boundaries and clarified optional semantic preparation

### Fixed

- Fixed eSpeak CLI clause handling and benchmark integration

### Documentation

- Documented batch processing usage
- Documented prepared-text usage and explicit Spokenform composition
